claims.text: The baselines compared against include neural models built on syntactic trees, latent trees, and non-tree models.

Specific models mentioned as baselines are Latent Syntax Tree-LSTM, Tree-based CNN, Gumbel Tree-LSTM, NSE, Reinforced Self-Attention Network, Residual stacked encoders, and BiLSTM with generalized pooling.
